articles.summary: Garanti BBVA has successfully completed the sale of its Romanian subsidiary to Raiffeisen Bank – the Romanian unit of the Austrian bank, Raiffeisen Bank International AG (RBI) – for €571 million, after receiving the necessary regulatory approvals.
articles.title: Garanti BBVA Completes the Sale of Its Romanian Subsidiary

articles.summary: BBVA has tapped the market today with a senior preferred debt issuance in Swiss francs. The green bond consists of two tranches: one maturing in four years (2030) and the other in seven years (2033). Initial price guidance for the four-year tranche is SARON Midswap + 75-80 basis points, while the seven-year tranche is priced at SARON Midswap + 90-95 basis points. UBS and Commerzbank are acting as bookrunners.
articles.title: BBVA places CHF 390 million in a two-tranche senior preferred green bond issuance
